record_grain: One entry in the saved NWEA research library extract. Different versions, appendices and summaries may be separate entries.
source_description_as_saved: nwea.org research library (WordPress REST API + publication pages)
retrieval_status: Imported from an existing saved snapshot. Its original collector, raw API responses, HTML responses and collection log were not supplied.
completeness: No claim that this snapshot covers every NWEA publication or every work by a listed researcher.
roster: The saved snapshot contains 22 researcher display names. Matching establishes roster membership only, not affiliation or employment at publication.
build: scripts/build_data.py rebuilds data.js, the CSV and QA report without network access.
transformations: Preserve all 317 entries, original IDs, posted dates, URLs and source bylines.
Derive publication classes from saved work types; use Journal article without independent peer-review claims.
Restore Sharon Bi in three contributor lists to match saved bylines; document other legacy aliases as unverified.
Recompute roster-match names from displayed contributors and the saved roster.
Export source_byline and contributors separately; omit the misleading authors_nwea_staff field.
Report missing fields and repeated titles rather than imputing metadata or dropping records.
interpretation: Posted dates do not establish original publication dates. March 2020 has 91 entries; calendar 2020 has 138.
Journal articles, working papers, briefs, appendices and presentations can describe the same study.
One edited book and one organizational byline are explicitly identified by QA for contribution-role handling.
Missing author names and unverified legacy aliases limit contributor metrics.
